resources.string: JobTap is a platform that connects users with part-time job opportunities. By using this application, you agree to the following terms and conditions.

JobTap opens external contact links to allow users to communicate with employers directly. We do not process any in-app applications, interviews, or hiring decisions. All communication and hiring processes occur outside of the application.

JobTap acts solely as a directory of job listings. We do not endorse, guarantee, or verify the accuracy of any job posting. Users are encouraged to exercise caution and perform their own due diligence when contacting employers.
We reserve the right to update these terms at any time. Continued use of the application after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
This Privacy Policy explains how JobTap collects, uses, and protects your information.
We collect an anonymous device identifier to distinguish unique installations of the app. This identifier is generated locally on your device and is not linked to any personal identity.

We detect your country code based on your device region and system settings. This device-region country is used first to deliver relevant job listings. If your device region is unavailable or invalid, we may use request metadata or IP address as a secondary fallback. This information is used to show you job listings relevant to your region.

We collect basic app analytics including the following event types: app open (app_open), job list view (job_list_view), job detail view (job_detail_view), and contact link click (contact_click). This data helps us improve the application and understand usage patterns.
In the current MVP (Minimum Viable Product), there is no account system. You do not need to create an account, provide an email address, or set a password to use JobTap.
We do not collect your name, email address, phone number, or any other personally identifiable information. We do not share your data with third parties for marketing purposes.
